description: This header file declares functions and includes for managing vendor modules in a software system, including loading, initializing, deinitializing, unloading, and setting defaults for vendor modules. It also includes license headers and include guards.

methods.name: wld_vendorModuleMgr_loadInternal
methods.description: Loads vendor modules registered in the local namespace and returns the count or an error code.

methods.name: wld_vendorModuleMgr_loadExternal
methods.description: Loads vendor modules from a specified shared object file and returns the count or an error code.

methods.name: wld_vendorModuleMgr_loadExternalDir
methods.description: Loads vendor modules from all shared object files in a specified directory and returns the count or an error code.

methods.name: wld_vendorModuleMgr_initAll
methods.description: Initializes all loaded vendor modules using provided initialization info, returns success or failure code.

methods.name: wld_vendorModuleMgr_deinitAll
methods.description: De-initializes all loaded vendor modules, returns success or failure code.

methods.name: wld_vendorModuleMgr_unloadAll
methods.description: Unloads all vendor modules and closes shared object files if external, returns success or failure code.

methods.name: wld_vendorModuleMgr_loadDefaultsAll
methods.description: Loads default datamodel configuration for all loaded vendor modules, returns success or failure code.
